THIRD-PARTY COMPONENTS IN TNFREE.EXE
====================================

SDL 3 (Simple DirectMedia Layer) - window, input, sound, timers
  https://libsdl.org  - zlib licence:
  Copyright (C) 1997-2025 Sam Lantinga <slouken@libsdl.org>
  This software is provided 'as-is', without any express or implied warranty.
  In no event will the authors be held liable for any damages arising from the
  use of this software. Permission is granted to anyone to use this software
  for any purpose, including commercial applications, and to alter it and
  redistribute it freely, subject to the following restrictions:
  1. The origin of this software must not be misrepresented; you must not
     claim that you wrote the original software. If you use this software in a
     product, an acknowledgment in the product documentation would be
     appreciated but is not required.
  2. Altered source versions must be plainly marked as such, and must not be
     misrepresented as being the original software.
  3. This notice may not be removed or altered from any source distribution.

Nuked OPL3 - FM music synthesis
  Copyright (C) 2013-2020 Nuke.YKT
  GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later.
  Source: https://github.com/nukeykt/Nuked-OPL3 (and third_party/nuked-opl3
  in the Freefall source).

FM music driver (port/audio/fmsynth.c) - how the game's music becomes FM
notes: frequency tables, volume and panning follow ScummVM's
reimplementation of the Miles Sound System AdLib driver
  Copyright (C) the ScummVM Team
  GNU General Public License, version 3 or later.
  Source: https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm (audio/miles_adlib.cpp)

FluidSynth 2.6.1 - SoundFont music
  Copyright (C) 2003-2025 Peter Hanappe and others (see its AUTHORS file).
  GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later.
  Source: https://github.com/FluidSynth/fluidsynth (tag v2.6.1). It is built
  into tnfree.exe from that source by the Freefall build (CMakeLists.txt), so
  tnfree.exe can be built again with a changed FluidSynth.

gcem - compile-time maths in FluidSynth
  Copyright (C) 2016-2024 Keith O'Hara. Apache License 2.0
  (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).
  Source: https://github.com/kthohr/gcem

stb_vorbis - OGG music packs
  Sean Barrett. Public domain (or MIT licence, at your choice).

dr_mp3 - MP3 music packs
  David Reid. Public domain (or MIT No Attribution, at your choice).

xBR-lv2 shader (screen filter "Smooth edges") - ported to HLSL
  Copyright (C) 2011-2016 Hyllian - sergiogdb@gmail.com. MIT licence:
  Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy
  of this software and associated documentation files (the "Software"), to deal
  in the Software without restriction, including without limitation the rights
  to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell
  copies of the Software, and to permit persons to whom the Software is
  furnished to do so, subject to the following conditions:
  The above copyright notice and this permission notice shall be included in
  all copies or substantial portions of the Software.
  THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR
  IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY,
  FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NONINFRINGEMENT. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE
  AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER
  LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
  OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN
  THE SOFTWARE.

CRT shader (screen filter "CRT") - ported to HLSL
  Timothy Lottes. Public domain.

stb_image_write - JPEG pictures of "tnfree --smooth-test"
  Sean Barrett. Public domain (or MIT licence, at your choice).

stb_image - PNG pictures of effects packs
  Sean Barrett. Public domain (or MIT licence, at your choice).

stb_truetype - the help screen's text
  Sean Barrett. Public domain (or MIT licence, at your choice).

tnfree.exe

Operation Stone Henge (the extra mission) - a mission for the first Terra
  Nova demo by Joerg Fischer (1999), in Terra Nova: Freefall with his
  permission. tnfree.exe holds only what he changed in the demo's and the
  game's files (the difference between the files he worked from and his
  own); the mission is made from your own files as it is played. The demo
  and the game are Looking Glass Technologies' (1996).

THIRD-PARTY FILES IN THE MUSIC FOLDER
=====================================

Freefall Music pack (Music/Freefall-MP3.zip) - the music the Freefall preset
  plays: Terra Nova's music recorded as MP3 by Rich "Weeds" Nagel
  (http://www.richnagel.net), shared with Terra Nova: Freefall with his
  permission (https://www.ttlg.com/forums/showthread.php?t=153031). The
  music itself is Terra Nova's (Looking Glass Technologies, 1996). The
  Freefall build takes this copy as it is; it is not part of the Freefall
  source.

GeneralUser GS 2.0.3 (Music/GeneralUser-GS.sf2) - the SoundFont the SoundFont
  music plays when you have chosen no other
  Copyright (C) 2000-2025 S. Christian Collins. GeneralUser GS License v2.0
  (Music/GeneralUser-GS-LICENSE.txt): free to use, change and pass on.
  https://www.schristiancollins.com (its source: github.com/mrbumpy409/
  GeneralUser-GS, commit 684543d5e5ef). The Freefall build takes this copy
  as it is; it is not part of the Freefall source.

THIRD-PARTY COMPONENTS IN TNFREE-RIFE.DLL ("Smooth videos")
===========================================================
The full licence texts are in the folder RIFE/licenses.

rife-ncnn-vulkan - RIFE frame interpolation on ncnn and Vulkan
  Copyright (c) 2020 nihui. MIT licence.
  Source: https://github.com/nihui/rife-ncnn-vulkan (and
  third_party/rife-ncnn-vulkan in the Freefall source, with one small change).

RIFE 4.6 model (RIFE/rife-v4.6) - from rife-ncnn-vulkan, MIT licence; RIFE by
  Zhewei Huang et al. (https://github.com/hzwer/Practical-RIFE, MIT licence).

ncnn - neural network inference
  Copyright (C) 2017 THL A29 Limited, a Tencent company. BSD 3-Clause licence
  (parts under the zlib licence). Source: https://github.com/Tencent/ncnn

glslang - shader compiler used by ncnn
  The Khronos Group Inc. and others: BSD 3-Clause, BSD 2-Clause, MIT and
  Apache 2.0 licences. Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glslang

Vulkan headers - The Khronos Group Inc., Apache 2.0 or MIT licence.

The Smacker movie decoder, the Miles-compatible sound mixer and the AWE32
bank converter (port/audio/sbkconv.c, after the SoundFont 1 rules Takashi Iwai
worked out for awesfx, GPL-2.0 or later) were written for Freefall and are
covered by its GPL-3.0 licence.

The full source code of Terra Nova: Freefall, including these components, is
available from the project's repository (GPL-3.0).
